name: Kasugai Teki
source:
She may look and act like a man, but she acted more like feminine when she was younger. Her chest looks flat because she usually always squashes it with sarashi because they are in the way.

She is not good at using her head and is more of an action-oriented person than a thinker.

[Translated from [url=http://nakenaiusagi.web.fc2.com/chara0.html]official website[/url]]
